The Econometrics team is responsible for developing analytical capabilities for SAS Econometrics and SAS/ETS, helping users address complex problems through classical and Bayesian methodology, causal discovery and causal inference, cross-sectional and panel data analysis, risk modeling, and simulation. The team combines econometrics and software engineering expertise to build high-performance modeling tools, including work in emerging areas such as Causal Analysis Agents.

As an intern, you might:

- Research econometric methods and computational algorithms, including approaches to causal discovery and causal inference.

- Contribute to research and development of agents for performing econometric analysis.

- Contribute to software development in Python or C/C++ to support SAS Econometrics capabilities.

- Design and run tests and simulation studies to assess model accuracy, computational performance, and software reliability.

- Create technical documentation and examples that demonstrate how to apply econometric methods to real-world problems.

- Collaborate with developers, domain experts, and testers, and present your project findings and recommendations to the team.

Required Qualifications

- You’re a Master's level student studying Econometrics, Statistics, Computer Science, Applied Math, Economics, Operations Research, or related quant field; not graduating prior to December 2027

- You have programming experience in one or more of the following: Python, C/C++

- You’re curious, passionate, authentic and accountable. These are Our SAS Values and influence everything we do.

- Strong communication skills - both written and verbal

- Leadership abilities. Your past experiences demonstrate you’ll take initiative and go above and beyond the call of duty.

- You are interested in the future of Analytics and embrace technology.

Preferred Qualifications

- Strong foundation in statistical methods, probability, and econometric modeling through coursework or research.

- Experience preparing and analyzing data, implementing analytical methods, and interpreting model results.

- Experience with the SAS system

- This position is located in Cary HQ (hybrid). You must be local to Cary HQ and willing to come to the office (Tuesday - Thursday).

- Interviews begin: On a rolling basis

- Work with (and learn from) the best. As a SAS intern, you’ll get face time with company leaders and executives.

- Hybrid work flexibility: Our hybrid approach offers the best of both worlds, combining in-office collaboration with the flexibility to work remotely, aligned with your team’s needs (minimum of 3 days in the office per week).

About Rippling

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.4B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

Our mission is to open the realm of possibilities and opportunities for students by fostering growth through mentorship and training, ownership through impactful and innovative projects, and, of course, fun through our diverse culture and work hard, play harder attitude. Interns will be assigned projects that not only have an impact on the business, but that are also scoped to fit within the time constraints of their internship so they can see the full impact of their work.

Your dedicated mentor and manager will provide support for your learning and development throughout your time with us. You will join your fellow interns in a variety of socials, talks with Rippling leaders, and more!

Our goal is to identify exceptional emerging engineers who can continue their careers at Rippling after graduation, growing into full-time contributors on our team.

- Utilize your software engineering experience to tackle important projects, solving problems, and developing quality code
- Think critically and apply your knowledge to real world, complex problems
- Actively participate in team meetings to scope, drive, and progress your projects
- Learn about the business, our clients’ needs, and the impact of your team and related projects
- Attend Meet & Greets with various executives and teams to gain a holistic view of what it takes to run a company like Rippling
- Foster relationships with your intern cohort and teams through both exclusive internship social events and company/office-wide events

- Previous internship/Co-op experience in software engineering, specifically in the backend with Python and the frontend using JavaScript and HTML/CSS

- Solid frontend programming skills with an emphasis on backend experience and knowledge
- Ability to adapt and ask action-oriented questions to progress
